blocklists_purpose: Public lists of torrents and addresses to block. None are connected until you choose them. A list can be strict: it may block far more than you expect.
blocklists_load_failed: Couldn't load the blocklists. Nothing was changed.
blocklists_stale: Couldn't refresh. What you see may be out of date.
blocklists_empty_text: Lodestar blocks nothing from public lists until you connect one below.
blocklists_measured: measured by Lodestar, not yet fetched
blocklists_held_text: The newest version of this list is much smaller or different, so it was held back. Keep the previous version, or accept the new one.
blocklists_catalog_help: Connecting shows how strict your lists would become before anything is applied.
blocklists_figures_ip: Blocks about {share} of public IPv4 addresses
blocklists_strictness_figures: Together: {hashes} torrents and about {share} of public IPv4 addresses.
blocklists_strictness_estimate: This is a lower bound: some lists haven't been fetched yet and lists may overlap.
blocklists_error_network: Lodestar couldn't be reached. Nothing was changed.
blocklists_error_url_refused: Lists can only be fetched from public addresses, not from a private, local or cloud-metadata address.
blocklists_error_url_bad: The list's address must start with http:// or https://, have a host name and no user name or password.
blocklists_error_name: A list's name must be 1 to 200 characters, with no hidden characters.
blocklists_error_changed: The list changed while you were reviewing it. Review it again.
blocklists_wizard_lead: Public blocklists can stop known-bad torrents and addresses. They are off, and you can skip this step. Choose a list only if you want its protection: stricter lists can block far more than you expect.
blocklists_wizard_none: Nothing is chosen, so nothing is connected.
blocklists_wizard_load_failed: Couldn't load the lists. You can connect them later in Settings.
blocklists_wizard_strictness_failed: Couldn't work out how strict your choice is, so nothing can be connected from here. Skip this step and connect lists in Settings.
blocklists_wizard_needs_settings: {name} needs your password or a closer look. Connect it in Settings → Blocklist subscriptions.
